title: SVG Mask Scroll Transition
description: Full-screen images that replace each other through SVG masks as you scroll: blinds opening from their centres or a grid of cells, with sliding text and a progress bar.

props.name: slides
props.type: { src: string; alt?: string; title?: ReactNode; label?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: One slide per image (three in the original), revealed in order; the text slides in after each image opens and out before the next.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The mask: 30 horizontal blinds opening bottom to top; a grid fading in at random; 12 vertical blinds with crossfading text (the first image starts shown); or the grid column by column.

props.name: container
props.description: The element that scrolls, when it is not the window. Give it container-type: size so the stage follows its size.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seed for the random cell orders of the grid patterns (stable across server and client renders).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The heading level of the slide titles.

a11y: Each slide's title is a real heading, and its label and description are text, all in reading order; an image with alt text is role="img" with that name, and one without is decorative.
Under prefers-reduced-motion nothing moves with scroll: the slides are shown one after another, each image in full with its text.
Scrolling stays native; the masks only follow the scroll position. Mask ids are unique per instance.
White text over images darkened to 80% brightness; under prefers-contrast: more the images are darkened further (55%) and the progress track is stronger.
usage: <SvgMaskScrollTransition pattern="vertical-blinds" slides={[{ src: "/a.jpg", title: "First" }, { src: "/b.jpg", title: "Second" }]} />
docs:
Installed `SvgMaskScrollTransition` in `components/ui/svg-mask-scroll-transition.tsx` (it uses `motion`). Place it full width in a page: `<SvgMaskScrollTransition slides={[{ src: "/a.jpg", title: "First", label: "Chapter one" }, ...]} />`. It is five screens tall; the stage sticks while you scroll through it.

Pick a mask with `pattern` (`horizontal-blinds`, `random-grid`, `vertical-blinds`, `column-grid`). Inside a scroll container, pass it as `container` and give it `container-type: size`. For the original feel, wrap the page in the Labs `smooth-scroll` item with `options={{ lerp: 0.15 }}`; the original uses Playfair Display and Shippori Mincho (load them yourself, or set `--svg-mask-scroll-transition-font`).

Ported from Hiro-kiii/Scroll-Transition (MIT, copyright 2009 - 2025 Codrops), with its GSAP timelines rewritten in Motion; the license text is in the file.
